name: Hugo
self_text: I am a Polish woman in my mid 30s with a background in biology. I enjoy fermenting hot sauce in my spare time. I am studying programming and work best with working through problems together. I need complete silence while working. I am happy to explain things. I can meet online and am free Saturday afternoon.

requests.request_text: I need you to be available Saturday afternoon. You have to be into working through problems together or a step-by-step walkthrough session, and it's a deal-breaker unless you are the one who has things explained by me. I'd strongly prefer that you are into programming, though I won't rule you out over it. It would be nice if you are okay with talking things through as we go or occasional short exchanges, and a small bonus if we overlap on online.
